An even target (5.0, 5.4, 6.0 mmol/L or 100, 108 mg/dL) allows meal SMBs, an odd target (5.5 mmol/L or 99 mg/dL) stops them. A temp target can switch them on or off.

string.comment: %1$s = time of the loop run, e.g. 14:05

string.name: mpc_smb_units
string.comment: %1$.2f = SMB in units. Example: SMB 0.80 U

resources.string: No meal seen: vanilla temp basal only
Meal seen, but the target is odd: no SMB
Meal seen, but an SMB is not allowed now

string.name: mpc_vanilla_temp
string.comment: %1$.2f = temp basal rate from vanilla OpenAPS in U/h, %2$.2f = profile basal rate in U/h. Example: Vanilla temp 0.45 U/h (profile basal 1.00 U/h)

string.name: mpc_meal_chance_line
string.comment: %1$d = meal chance from the data in percent, %2$d = meal chance after the room rule in percent. Example: Meal chance 23% from the rise, 61% with the room above the target

resources.string: Meal chance %1$d%% from the rise, %2$d%% with the room above the target

string.name: mpc_room_mmol
string.comment: %1$.1f = BG above the target in mmol/L

string.name: mpc_room_mgdl
string.comment: %1$.0f = BG above the target in mg/dL

string.name: mpc_lines_mmol
string.comment: %1$.1f = target, %2$.1f = high line, both in mmol/L. Example: Target 5.5, high line 8.0 mmol/L

string.name: mpc_lines_mgdl
string.comment: %1$.0f = target, %2$.0f = high line, both in mg/dL. Example: Target 99, high line 144 mg/dL

string.name: mpc_isf_mmol
string.comment: %1$.1f = profile ISF in mmol/L per U. Example: ISF 2.6 mmol/L/U

string.name: mpc_isf_mgdl
string.comment: %1$.0f = profile ISF in mg/dL per U. Example: ISF 47 mg/dL/U
